headline: One evidence graph now keeps startup, availability, staged artifacts, publishers, and public release truth coherent.

items.title: Startup evidence gained honest temporal ownership
items.insight: Last-closeout claims no longer masquerade as current checks, and both legacy and v3 SIL ledgers forecast cleanly. A fresh session can now tell what was true then from what is verified now.

items.title: Availability became a truthful vector
items.insight: Strict continuity, origin content, edge liveness, and ingest health now answer separate questions with separate denominators. The 47.3% incident signal stays visible without falsely calling reachable pages down.

items.title: The production Worker mismatch became route-observed
items.insight: Five bounded probes now distinguish the expected Worker from a Pages fallthrough without retaining bodies, cookies, or identifiers. Production currently matches zero of five route contracts, so the incident has a precise signature.

items.title: Exact staging now proves critical content, not only commit identity
items.insight: A deterministic 24-leaf SHA-256 Merkle root binds the candidate's critical files. Canonical staging serves the same root and leaf count, closing the partial-deploy blind spot behind an exact SHA beacon.

items.title: The pre-push boundary became source-aware
items.insight: Changed sources now trigger every affected evidence builder and check before a push. The gate proved its teeth by catching a stale embedded feed during this session instead of letting closeout fossilize it.

items.title: Derived truth gained one transitive dependency graph
items.insight: Build order, pre-push closure, and scheduled publishers now consume one validated acyclic graph. It immediately found three workflow gaps, which is exactly the sort of useful rudeness a good invariant should provide.

followUps: Append route-provenance history only when semantics change and calculate incident duration.
Render the evidence graph as a human and agent-readable projection.
Complete Supabase runtime authority and the real-provider ceremony before production promotion.
blockers: Supabase management, SQL migration, and Edge Function authority remain unavailable.
Production Worker restoration remains behind the explicit auth/security promotion hold.

honestyLedger.title: No uptime massage
honestyLedger.why: Strict full-stack continuity remains 47.3%; content reachability is a separate dimension.

honestyLedger.title: No historical probe fabrication
honestyLedger.why: Legacy rows do not claim edge or ingest observations that were never collected.

honestyLedger.title: No false visual attestation
honestyLedger.why: The failed OS image-return bridge is recorded; automated Axe/contrast/screenshots remain the evidence.

honestyLedger.title: No static-green production promotion
honestyLedger.why: Exact staging cannot waive runtime and provider gates.
